# Anatomy Assets

Place the following 4 generated eye anatomy images here:

| File | Usage | Recommended Size |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| `eye-hero.png` | Dashboard hero background watermark | 1200×800 |
| `eye-labeled.png` | Case session sidebar diagram | 600×600 |
| `eye-medallion.png` | Onboarding logo watermark | 300×300 |
| `eye-flashcard.png` | Flashcard header visual | 480×320 |

Visual spec: ultra-realistic eye cross-section showing retina, macula, cornea, fovea, choroid.
Warm-tinted (bronze/sepia tone), white or transparent background.
The app applies `filter: sepia(0.3) saturate(0.8)` and `mix-blend-mode: multiply` at render time.
